Social Image Sizer

Resize any image to exact social media dimensions — Instagram post, story, Facebook cover, X header, YouTube thumbnail, LinkedIn and more — with cover or fit modes.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your image.
  2. Pick a social platform preset (or enter a custom size).
  3. Choose Cover (crop to fill) or Fit (whole image, blurred padding).
  4. Download the perfectly-sized PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which presets are included?

Instagram Post (1080×1080), Instagram Story/Reel (1080×1920), Facebook Post (1200×630), Facebook Cover (820×312), X Header (1500×500), X Post (1200×675), YouTube Thumbnail (1280×720), LinkedIn Post (1200×627) and Pinterest Pin (1000×1500).

What is the difference between Cover and Fit?

“Cover” fills the whole frame and crops the overflow (best for backgrounds). “Fit” shows the entire image with blurred padding filling the rest.

Can I set a custom size?

Yes — a custom width and height option lets you set any size.

Is my image uploaded?

No — resizing happens entirely in your browser.
